objective: Improve every accepted song and video through evidence-bound continuous learning.

baseline.rule: The baseline is a minimum floor, never a target ceiling.

plan: define the musical hypothesis and intended listener experience
select genre, tempo, harmonic language, ensemble and arrangement goals
write measurable acceptance criteria before generation
do: generate or arrange a complete instrumental track
mix with stable dynamics and controlled crossfades
check: check composition, harmony, groove, instrumentation, realism, continuity and technical audio
reject any track that merely matches the baseline
act: record the listener decision and reasons
update prompts, arrangement rules, model settings and QA thresholds
promote only a clearly improved track
carry unresolved defects into the next plan

hard_rejections: sounds obviously synthetic or like a demo
has abrupt rhythm, key, energy or instrumentation changes
is equal to the current baseline without a documented improvement
